card.line: Every AICTE application verdict, with proof.

say: Good morning. Hum team hain, aur hamara problem statement SIH26261 hai, AICTE ka: AI se application validation, document authentication aur compliance verification. Hamara solution hai Pramaan, jiska matlab hai proof.

card.line: Manual checks are slow. An edited certificate looks genuine. Nobody can compare one faculty list with every other college.

say: AICTE approval ke liye har institution land deed, building certificate, fire certificate aur faculty list deta hai, aur officers ye sab haath se padhte hain. Isme teen problems hain. Ye slow hai. Edit kiya hua certificate aankh se asli lagta hai. Aur koi officer ek college ki faculty list ko baaki saare colleges se compare nahi kar sakta.

card.line: One verdict: Compliant, Reject, or Human review. Every finding quotes its source.

say: Pramaan poora application padhta hai aur teen me se ek verdict deta hai: compliant, reject, ya human review. Har finding ke saath document ki wahi line dikhti hai jahan se wo aayi. Jahan shak ho, wahan ye khud approve nahi karta.
Ab live demo dekhte hain. Ye ek fictional college ka sahi application hai, Shree Ram Institute of Technology. Ek click me Pramaan ne saare documents padh liye aur verdict diya: compliant.

cap: Faculty ratio from the AICTE handbook
say: Ye check dekhiye. 480 students pe 25 faculty hain, yaani 19.2 students per faculty. AICTE handbook ke Annexure 5 me limit 20 hai, isliye pass. Aur neeche wo exact line dikhti hai jahan se ye number aaya.

cap: Built-up area worked out room by room
say: Building area bhi andaaze se nahi hai. Annexure 3 ke room-wise table se calculate hua hai: classrooms, labs, library, sab jod ke. 5,562 square metre chahiye, aur certificate pe 6,000 hai.
Ab forgery. Is college ka fire certificate March 2026 me expire ho chuka hai. Application September 2026 ki hai, toh ye reject hona chahiye.

cap: Expired date covered, new date typed on top
say: Kisi ne date ke upar white box lagaya aur 2027 type kar diya. Page dekhiye, aankh se bilkul theek lagta hai. Officer ise pass kar sakta hai. Par laal box me Pramaan dikha raha hai ki chhedchhad kahan hui.

cap: White box, odd font, saved after issue
say: Pramaan ne white box, alag font, aur file ka dobara save hona, teeno pakde. Aur white box ke neeche asli date abhi bhi file me hai, Pramaan wahi padhta hai.

cap: Land is not in the trust's name
say: Saath hi land trust ke naam nahi, ek private person ke naam nikli. Pramaan ne do alag documents khud mila ke pakad liya.

cap: Printed and scanned: no edit marks left
say: Ab smart forger. Ye page ko print karke scan kar deta hai, taaki edit ka koi nishaan na bache. Ab white box nahi, alag font nahi, page pe seedha 2027 likha hai.

cap: The QR code still holds the true date
say: Par QR code me abhi bhi 2026 hai. Pramaan QR padhta hai, page se compare karta hai, aur reject kar deta hai.

cap: A second college. Every file looks fine.
say: Ab sabse important case. Ye ek doosra college hai, Ganga College of Engineering. Iska har document apne aap me bilkul theek hai. Koi edit nahi, koi expired date nahi.

cap: 25 faculty are already on another college's record
say: Par Pramaan purani applications yaad rakhta hai. Iski 25 faculty pehle se Shree Ram Institute ki list me hain. Yani ek hi log do colleges me dikhaye ja rahe hain. Isi ko ghost faculty kehte hain.

cap: The fire certificate number is already in use
say: Fire certificate ka number bhi wahi hai jo pehle college ne diya tha. Ye ek file dekh ke kabhi nahi pakda ja sakta.
Ye officer ka screen hai. Saari applications ek queue me, sabse risky sabse upar, aur har application ki PDF report evidence ke saath. REST API bhi hai, toh AICTE portal seedha connect ho sakta hai.

card.line: Read. Classify. Extract. Verify. Check norms. Authenticate. Remember. Verdict.

say: Andar kya chalta hai? Document padha jaata hai, scanned ho toh offline OCR se. Phir norms check hote hain, forgery checks chalte hain, aur registry purani applications se milati hai.

Free-form letters Gemini padhta hai, par uski baat seedhi nahi maani jaati. Value tabhi rakhi jaati hai jab uski source line document me sach me ho, aur numbers exact match karein. Warna wo officer ke paas jaati hai.

card.line: Working live link. 29 automated tests. Norms from the AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024-27.

say: Ye sirf idea nahi hai. Live link chal raha hai, 29 automated tests pass hain, aur norms seedhe AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024-27 se liye gaye hain.

card.line: Tested on synthetic documents so far. A careful photo edit with no QR code is not caught yet.

say: Hum limits bhi saaf batate hain. Abhi tak sirf synthetic documents pe test hua hai, asli scans mushkil honge. Aur photo pe bahut safai se ki gayi editing, agar QR ya signature na ho, abhi nahi pakdi jaati.

card.line: Officers focus on risky files. Honest colleges know what to fix. Students get real faculty and safe buildings.

say: Officers ka time risky applications pe lagta hai, honest colleges ko pata chalta hai kya theek karna hai, aur students ko milti hai asli faculty aur safe building.

card.line: AI proposes. Code verifies. Anything uncertain goes to a human, with the reason.

say: Pramaan: har verdict, proof ke saath. Thank you.
